prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: illustration for an elaborated edition of an existing Swedish children's book, predominantly read on mobile. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: a photograph of the original book page. Edit the actual existing illustration from this image, retaining its EXACT wonky black pen outlines, strokes, crosshatching, character faces, poses, proportions, asymmetries, and relative composition. This is the same artist's actual illustration being gently elaborated, not a replacement character design. Remove ALL handwriting and text, the surrounding wooden table, fingers, photography shadows, page edges, bindings, and book edges. Output only a clean illustration on warm offwhite paper (#f8f1e5), with ample breathing room. Add restrained translucent watercolor washes and subtle shallow paper-cut three-dimensional relief shadows. Make the relief feel like the original pen drawing lifted a few millimetres from paper, never a polished toy or glossy 3D render. Use warm ochre, sage green, muted dusty blue, and occasional plum accents, retaining the strong irregular black ink as the visual authority. Sparse added scenery must use the exact same unsteady hand-drawn strokes, hatch marks, and imperfect simplicity as the original. No typography or lettering anywhere. Avoid generic cartoons, anime, Disney/Pixar appearance, smooth vector outlines, photorealism, rounded plastic, busy backdrops, decorative borders, sparkles, or new characters.
Subject and composition: Preserve the original full-body smiling Doctor Ann, hands in long coat pockets, short uneven hair, loose trousers and rounded shoes, with the original scattered tufts of grass. Use the actual portrait from the lower-left of the page as the illustration. Remove the handwritten text above and right. Her coat stays warm white with a very light dusty-blue watercolor shadow, hair ochre brown, trousers very muted plum, grass sage. The original photograph's finger hides part of the bottom-left coat hem/shoe; reconstruct only those minimally missing lines in the same imperfect pen stroke, preserving all visible lines. Add only a small soft ground shadow and sparse wash of outdoor air. Center the complete figure with grass in a portrait or almost-square illustration.
